text: Eight distinct legal-wrapper structures appear across the forty DAOs, and the purpose-built Wyoming DAO LLC has been adopted by only one, a striking under-utilization of available statutory infrastructure.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Institutional Deficit in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations - An Empirical Analysis (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6819121

isBasedOn.name: The Institutional Deficit in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations - An Empirical Analysis

abstract: The Wyoming DAO LLC, despite being a purpose-built statute, has been adopted by only one DAO in the entire forty-DAO sample. This is a striking under-utilization of available statutory infrastructure.
